title: Nonhuman overarching frame: identity models, carrier audiences and live routing
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full synthesis/router proposal; ontology, record and implementation authority separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full read covers six identity distinctions, Identity:O1–O8, seven continuity subjects, three walks, AR1–AR5, thirteen glossary groups, twenty-six lane pointers, OV1–OV20 and S1–S5. Person, soul, mind, body, controller and record are useful distinctions when a selected case consumes them, not six universal metaphysical substances or six mandatory schemas. O1+O8 remains a recommendation, not an accepted global ontology. An executable return, ownership or learning contract can be explicit while philosophical same-person continuity stays intentionally uncertain. A new database ID, archive or appearance alone does not decide that truth.

F2. Preserve the actual continuity carrier and audience: human player learning, profile unlock, soul memory and local world account have different scopes and lifetimes. Conflicting legends, false diaries and surviving records need not converge to author truth. Metaknowledge can guide a supported attempt without manufacturing character certainty or punishing a clever guess. A later O1-to-O6 projection event need not retcon the original life into secret possession. A perfect backup, soul recognition or reliable shared memory can genuinely join distinctions through its selected source; ordinary-case separation is not a ban on stronger means under AD38.

F3. Same-instance return, branch counterpart, independent later resident and restored person retain different histories. Borrowing has anchor and vessel aftermath, actual goods/obligations and any local household; extraction does not liquidate residents by implication. A place-body's reach is not title to its inhabitants or automatic transport of them. Paradise may connect a selected crossing without becoming the origin of every native life, O8 player or soul. Permission to enter does not supply habitat, citizenship or the destination's actual body/source law. Free carry/conversion works where its real source supplies it; preservation of carriers does not invent a universal surcharge or force every retained habit to grant power.

F4. The pointer table is a dated availability snapshot. The cheats report has now been fully read in B237, and the implementation-implications checkpoint was fully read in B232; neither remains an absent lane. Micro/minds/progression/monster-side and earlier nonhuman owners now have full-review dispositions in this reconciliation, while body-authoring/start-specs/requirements and other remaining bodies keep their actual intake state. A completed checkpoint is not full body review. Qualify overlapping O/BS/BI/BK/MF codes by owner; a shared abbreviation is not a merged identity or contract. Keep this frame a router and preserve actual source/translation gaps rather than create a new canon or runtime authority.

F5. The old HP/D&D-first ordering, one-realm/prestige milestone and1366-primary view are historical. Current LOTM/Klein and Harry developer-route direction, desktop prose-first independent panes and current compatibility/proof owners govern selected work. Local quiet lives, mixed societies, remembered traces and optional arcs remain useful; no full ontology, multiverse service, body collection or all-world civilization system is a prerequisite. AD52/ACR compression retains consequential identities, obligations and causes when routine narration shrinks. Under AD32 these arcs/defaults are proposals; AD42 keeps human review optional. No new source-code, primary-canon, runtime, persistence, UI or installed-game claim follows from this read.
reviews.evidence: Entire361-line input delivered in ranges1–130,131–255,256–361. Table pointers do not count as linked-body reads or new current-code/canon verification.
reviews.reopen: Selected continuity/identity/arrival consumer or changed accepted direction; qualify exact actual carrier/audience and maintain incumbent owners.
